_cases: P09: each case patches the parse tables so state 0 reduces one rule R (state actions -> negative entry, default rule[0] = R, ruleGotos[R] -> goto table entry 0 = reduce state 0x4AC, rule 0x235, which fails and ends the run); top = valueStack+1, so top[-k] sits at @valueStack+0x1010-0x10k and top[0] is the zeroed initial value. The 0xEC chain shifts token 0 (top[0] = parser token value) into rule 0xED, then 0x187 (appends a region), then 0xEC, all with rule length 0.
